description: This file defines a FavoritesFragment class for an Android app, managing the display of user's favorite recipes using RecyclerView and handling UI states such as loading, empty, and content.

classes.name: FavoritesFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a list of favorite recipes, manages view states and handles navigation to detail screens.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up the adapter, and triggers loading of favorite recipes.

methods.name: loadFavorites
methods.description: Fetches favorite recipes asynchronously and updates the UI based on the data received.
